items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: It did come up and it hit Berk and we all went down in a mine.

ctx.x: So we packed up all my mother's sheet music and mandolin and stuff like that and got out of the rooming house that we lived in where my mother was working and it was like a rooming house beanery. She used to get up at three o'clock in the morning to start the breakfast.

Anyway the fire started coming up sure enough. It did come up and it hit Berk and we all went down in a mine. They took us down in this mine and people brought all their belongings down there and the town burned down over us. The next morning we came out and there was no town. People were poking around looking for things and there was nothing left at all. The whole thing burned up while we were underground.
But you had your mother's sheet music and mandolin?
